description: This file defines the Gmac class implementing Galois Message Authentication Code (GMAC) using AES encryption, including methods for updating data, finalizing the authentication tag, and performing finite field multiplication.

classes.name: Gmac
classes.description: Class implementing GMAC (Galois Message Authentication Code) with methods for data processing and authentication tag generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Gmac object with AES key, nonce, and key size, setting up internal buffers and precomputations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the GMAC with additional data blocks, processing full and partial blocks.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the GMAC computation, producing the authentication tag based on associated data and ciphertext lengths.

methods.name: bit
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bit from a ByteArray at a given index.

methods.name: blockMultiply
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication of two 16-byte ByteArrays, critical for GMAC.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Processes any remaining bytes in the internal buffer to update the authentication state.
